description:
Manager checkpoint for milestone M1 (`b9aaf03c-c564-4798-b4fc-968ae7932d4a`, due 2026-11-21).

WHY THIS CARD EXISTS
The M1 demo needs an audience and a sign-off owner, and neither is named. Asked of management on 18 Nov with a decide-by of Thu 20 Nov 12:00; nothing on the board wakes at that moment, so without this card the decision can be missed and the demo drifts silently.

THE DECISION (options, recommendation, default)
- Option A — management attends Fri 2026-11-21 14:00 Europe/Madrid, 15 min (5 min walkthrough: clean host → demo/up.sh → demo URL → login → workspace list → open one workspace), sign-off owner named. RECOMMENDED.
- Option B — demo moves to Mon 2026-11-24 14:00 because the audience is unavailable. Cost: M1's feedback no longer re-orders the backlog before M2 starts on 23 Nov.
- Option C — no live audience: record the walkthrough and post it on `b9aaf03c`. Ship-and-show continues; acceptance is recorded rather than demonstrated.
- DEFAULT IF NO ANSWER BY 2026-11-20 12:00 = Option C. The increment keeps moving; nothing waits for an audience. Record the fallback on `b9aaf03c` in one line.

WHAT TO DO ON WAKE
1. Read `b9aaf03c` for the owner's evidence (command sequence, docker compose state, HTTP status, screenshot) and its forecast/actual state.
2. If a sign-off owner and a slot are named, write them into the shift report and set `b9aaf03c` due date accordingly; close this card.
3. If not, apply Option C: state the fallback on `b9aaf03c`, keep the 21 Nov date, and re-forecast M2 (`299d12ce`, due 25 Nov) only if M1's evidence is missing or broken.
4. If M1 has no evidence at all by 12:00 on 20 Nov, move M1 to `onhold`, report it as **off track** with the named failing step, and raise it as a management decision instead of a date change.

ACCEPTANCE: this card ends with either a named slot + sign-off owner, or the explicit Option C fallback recorded on `b9aaf03c`, plus a one-line M1 status (on track / at risk / off track) in the shift report.

**Do not** record a final go/no-go at 12:00 as though the 18:00 session and the 17:00 verdict could not still change it. The authoritative gate is the 21 Nov 09:00 rehearsal.

## PM finding (shift #7, 2026-11-19) — the 21 Nov slot is a SATURDAY

**21 Nov 2026 is a Saturday.** 26 Nov 2026 is the 4th Thursday of November, so 19 Nov = Thursday, **20 Nov = Friday, 21 Nov = Saturday**. This is not an opinion; it is the calendar. Note that `def4ce38`'s own text calls it "Fri 21 Nov" — that wrong weekday is exactly how the error entered the plan and has been copied forward ever since.

**Consequence.** Every card that protects the demo falls on Saturday:

| Card | Wake (UTC) | Madrid |
|---|---|---|
| `101588b6` rehearsal | Sat 09:00Z | 10:00 Sat |
| `4f055e99` NO-GO branch | Sat 10:30Z | 11:30 Sat |
| `def4ce38` evidence pack | Sat 11:00Z | 12:00 Sat |
| `6bceef9e` pre-flight | Sat 12:15Z | 13:15 Sat |
| demo / sign-off | Sat 13:00Z | 14:00 Sat |
| `70832a68` outcome + re-forecast | Sat 16:00Z | 17:00 Sat |

The ProjectManager seat is **mon–fri 09:00–19:00 Europe/Madrid**. So on demo day there is no PM on duty: the NO-GO branch fires without anyone to communicate it, and the re-forecast that re-orders M2/M3 also runs unattended. And a management demo at 14:00 on a Saturday is an audience nobody has confirmed.

**What is NOT at risk:** M1's content. The increment is built and the recorded walkthrough exists precisely so acceptance does not depend on a room. What is at risk is the *demonstration and the cover*.

### Options

- **A — keep Sat 21 Nov 13:00Z.** Cost 0 now. Accept: M1 is accepted on the recording; the live slot is probably empty; no PM cover; a NO-GO is executed by a seat with nobody to notify. Cheapest, weakest.
- **B — move the whole chain +2 days to Mon 23 Nov (RECOMMENDED).** Everything lands on a working day, with the PM seat on duty for the NO-GO and the re-forecast.
- **C — Fri 20 Nov 13:00Z.** **Ruled out, not an option:** the QA verdict is 17:00Z and the CISO allow 17:30Z on 20 Nov — the file would not be cleared until after the demo.

### Why B is cheap despite moving five cards
- `demo/` is frozen from 20 Nov 17:30Z; the freeze simply lasts three days longer. Nothing needs editing over the weekend (`2639c296` is already evidence-only).
- **M2 and M3 do not move.** `299d12ce` kicks off Mon 23 Nov 09:00Z, the same morning. That is correct, not a collision: a kickoff is not a build, and the M1 feedback then re-orders M2 in the afternoon at `70832a68` — which is precisely the "demo, then re-plan" rule.
- The CISO gate `fb3a93dc` (20 Nov 17:30Z) and the QA verdict `140c8fb0` (17:00Z) do not move: they clear the file, not the slot.

### Cascade if B is chosen — exact values, apply all six

2. `4f055e99` → wake `2026-11-23T10:30:00Z`
3. `def4ce38` → wake `2026-11-23T11:00:00Z`
4. `6bceef9e` → wake `2026-11-23T12:15:00Z`
5. `70832a68` → wake `2026-11-23T16:00:00Z`

**One text correction that must ride with it:** `4f055e99` branch 4 proposes "Mon 24 Nov 13:00Z" as the replacement slot after a NO-GO. Once the demo is on Mon 23 Nov, that proposal is "Tue 24 Nov 13:00Z" — otherwise a failed Monday would propose replacing itself with the same day.

Ask management for explicit confirmation of a weekday slot. **If there is no answer by 12:00Z, apply B.** An unconfirmed Saturday slot was never a commitment, and this card exists to convert a forecast into one. Do not absorb the move silently: post the new date and the reason in the same comment.

## PM correction (shift #7, turn 3) — **Option B is no longer free.** The cascade I filed last turn is wrong and is superseded here.

Last turn I filed Option B as *"move the whole chain to Mon 23 Nov — M2 and M3 dates unaffected"*. That was true when I wrote it. It is **no longer true**, and the decision at 12:00Z must see the real cost.

Turns 2–3 of this shift had to move the **QA infrastructure chain** twice: first off 20 Nov 16:00Z (it would have declared a never-executed pytest suite 46 minutes before the M1 QA verdict, blocking M1 on infrastructure that is not part of M1), and then off **23 Nov** — because 23 Nov is exactly where Option B puts the demo. Final home: `d1ba037a` **24 Nov 10:00Z** → `5ee9dbfa` **24 Nov 12:00Z** → `716c63f8` **24 Nov 14:00Z**.

Consequence: **24 Nov is now occupied by QA infrastructure.** M2 cannot start on 24 Nov at 09:00Z, because `d1ba037a` declares the suite at 10:00Z and M2's own DoD says *"QA gate not `block`"*.

### Option A (keep Sat 21 Nov) — cost: zero downstream
`101588b6` 09:00Z · `4f055e99` 10:30Z · `def4ce38` 11:00Z · `6bceef9e` 12:15Z · **demo 13:00Z** · `70832a68` 16:00Z. M2 `299d12ce` **23 Nov 09:00Z**, M3 `140668fe` **24 Nov 09:00Z**, `76b7c8e2` **25 Nov 09:00Z**, `1ad984aa` **25 Nov 16:00Z** — all unchanged.

### Option B (move the chain to Mon 23 Nov) — cost: **+1 day on M2, M3 and everything after**
Demo chain, six values: `101588b6` → **23 Nov 09:00Z** · `4f055e99` → **23 Nov 10:30Z** (its replacement slot, if NO-GO, becomes Tue 24 Nov) · `def4ce38` → **23 Nov 11:00Z** · `6bceef9e` → **23 Nov 12:15Z** · demo slot → **23 Nov 13:00Z** · `70832a68` → **23 Nov 16:00Z**.

And now, new:
- `299d12ce` M2 start 23 Nov 09:00Z → **24 Nov 09:00Z**… which collides with the QA chain. So → **25 Nov 09:00Z**.
- `140668fe` M3 24 Nov 09:00Z → **26 Nov 09:00Z** (M3 depends on M2).
- `76b7c8e2` verify efforts 25 Nov 09:00Z → **26 Nov 16:00Z** (after M3 starts).
- `1ad984aa` M2 boundary 25 Nov 16:00Z → **27 Nov 16:00Z**.

That is a **two-day** slip to M2, not one, once the QA chain is respected. I am not hiding it.

### The decision, restated with the real numbers
- **Option A — keep Sat 21 Nov 13:00Z.** Cost: M1 is signed off on the **recorded** walkthrough (the 11:00Z evidence pack), not a live demo; nobody from the PM seat is on duty that day; if the rehearsal fails, the NO-GO call is made by `devops` alone. Downstream: **nothing moves.**

**My recommendation is still B**, and now for a sharper reason than comfort: our own delivery rule says a milestone that is never demoed live is not accepted. Two days of M2/M3 slip is cheaper than a milestone accepted on a recording. But A is now a *legitimate* option — it costs nothing downstream — and management may prefer it.

1. **Who signs M1 off.** No name = the demo is a show, not an acceptance.
2. **Whether the QA line is accepted as deferred.** M1 demos without `qa_policy` test evidence (it lands 24 Nov). That is a scope change already applied; it needs an explicit yes, not a silence.
3. **The applied QA-chain dates** (24 Nov 10:00/12:00/14:00Z) are **not conditional** — they stay whichever option is chosen.

No card that changes what the QA gate means may wake on any day that could be a demo day. Candidate demo days: **21 Nov** and **23 Nov**. Apply this rule before scheduling anything new near a demo.

## PM reconciliation (shift #7, turn 3) — **your description and my two comments define the options three different ways. This comment is the authoritative version. Read it before anything else on 12:00Z.**

1. It says *"management attends Fri 2026-11-21 14:00"*. **21 Nov 2026 is a Saturday.** (26 Nov 2026 is the 4th Thursday of November ⇒ 19 Thu, 20 Fri, **21 Sat**.) This line is where the weekday error entered the board and got copied onto five other cards.
2. It says Option B is *"Mon 2026-11-24"*. **24 Nov 2026 is a Tuesday.** The Monday is **23 Nov**.

I cannot rewrite the description through the task API, so the corrections live here and supersede it.

### Canonical option letters — use the DESCRIPTION's letters, not mine
To avoid a fourth vocabulary, the description's A/B/C are canonical. My earlier comments used A/B differently; this is the mapping:

| Canonical | Meaning | My earlier label |
|---|---|---|
| **A** | Live demo **Sat 21 Nov 13:00Z**, sign-off owner named, PM not on duty | = my "Option A" |
| **B** | Demo moves to **Mon 23 Nov 13:00Z** (live, working day) | = my "Option B" |
| **C** | No live audience: the **11:00Z evidence pack is the demo**, 21 Nov date kept | ≈ my "Option A" |

Note **A and C differ only in whether an audience appears**. They cost the same and keep every date.

### The default — I am reversing my own ruling from earlier this shift, on purpose
Earlier today I filed *"no answer ⇒ Option B"*. That was correct when Option B cost **nothing** downstream. It no longer does: this shift moved the QA infrastructure chain to 24 Nov (to keep it off both candidate demo days), so Option B now pushes **M2 → 25 Nov, M3 → 26 Nov, verify → 26 Nov, boundary → 27 Nov**. A two-day slip of delivery must never be the product of silence.

**Default if no answer by 12:00Z: keep 21 Nov. Apply C (the recording is the demo), and A if someone turns up.** Do **not** move any date on silence. Moving a date is a decision; silence is not one.

### At 12:00Z, do exactly this
1. **Record the slot as confirmed-for-21-Nov unless a human moved it.** No date changes without a named authorisation.
2. **Name the sign-off owner, or record explicitly that M1 is accepted on the 11:00Z recording.** One of the two — not "TBC".
3. **Record acceptance that M1 demos without `qa_policy` test evidence.** It lands 24 Nov (`d1ba037a` 10:00Z → `5ee9dbfa` 12:00Z → `716c63f8` 14:00Z). That is a real scope change and needs an explicit yes.
4. **Confirm `4f055e99` has NO-GO authority for the 21 Nov window**, with `devops` alone on duty. If the rehearsal at 09:00Z fails, that card calls it and notifies before 13:00Z; nobody needs to reach a PM.
5. **If M1 has no evidence at all by 12:00Z:** move `b9aaf03c` to `onhold`, report **off track** with the named failing step — do not convert a missing increment into a date change.

### What NOT to do
- Do not apply description step 3 as written ("apply Option C: … keep the 21 Nov date, and re-forecast M2 only if M1's evidence is missing") — the re-forecast clause is fine, but "keep the date" must not become "keep a date nobody confirmed" without step 1 recorded.
